experiment.description: Repeated serving performance measurements built around user_scripts/exp5_serving_perf.py

protocol.independence: Each repetition uses a distinct seed, a fresh server process for each model/runtime-mode group, and a cache flush before every measured cell.
protocol.request_scheduling: Open-loop dispatch with 1/rps spacing and asynchronous response collection.
protocol.ttft: Milliseconds from HTTP request start until arrival of the first streamed output-token chunk; per-repetition cell statistic is the arithmetic mean after warmup exclusion.
protocol.throughput: Measured output tokens after warmup exclusion divided by wall-clock seconds from first dispatch until all requests complete; the denominator conservatively includes warmup time.
protocol.aggregation: Per-cell arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, and two-sided 95% Student t confidence interval across the three independent repetitions (df=2, t*=4.302652729911275).

balanced_public.public_prefix_prewarm: For system_prompt only: operator-authorized Verified-Public system prefix is installed after cache flush. Other workloads run independently under balanced mode without a public prefix.

shared_system_prompt_emulation.label: Shared System Prompt baseline (emulated)
shared_system_prompt_emulation.public_prefix_prewarm: Operator-authorized Verified-Public fixed system prefix is installed after cache flush; only that prefix is shared, while each request carries a user-specific private suffix.
shared_system_prompt_emulation.interpretation: Emulates fixed shared system-prefix plus private-suffix semantics; it is not presented as a native separately implemented policy.

cache_partition.reason: The available cache-partition mapping is the same per-principal strict runtime. It is recorded as an alias and is not rerun or emitted as independent numeric evidence.

CacheSolidarity.reason: No runnable CacheSolidarity implementation is available in this repository; no measurements are fabricated.
